title: Winter Olympics
metaDescription: The Winter Olympics combine snow and ice sports across a host region rather than one compact stadium district

overview.about: The Winter Olympic Games bring together the world's best skiers, skaters, sliders and snowboarders every four years - a fortnight of speed and spectacle in the mountains. First held in Chamonix in 1924, the Games have grown from a handful of events to a global showcase of winter sport. The 2030 Games are hosted across the French Alps.
overview.nextEvent: The 2030 Winter Olympics run 1-18 February across the French Alps, returning the Games to France for the first time since Albertville 1992. Events are spread between mountain resorts and valley towns, from Alpine skiing and biathlon to figure skating and bobsleigh.
